notes.title: Mega Update
notes.notes: For no reason at all, the game has been reworked. Lots of features are missing to slowly build the game up properly. There will probably be many crashes but don't worry they will be worked on in the future. Game play is smoother and less laggy.

notes.title: Congrats Somebody
notes.notes: Less than a day after adding achievements, somebody has already taken the liberty of hacking to unlock them all. I am so proud. Here is a shout out they who is clearly my biggest fans. You do [u]Gods[/u] work.
